testsuite.name: com.bontecou.syncmd.services.git.RepositoryActivityTest

testcase.name: local commit records completion and failed push keeps that time and commit
failed commit and read only fetch planning do not invent completion
optional metadata write failure does not report a completed commit as failed
metadata corruption and symlinks never expose invented times or alter their targets
branch completion records time but dirty checkout refusal does not
successful pull and acknowledged push persist across service reopen and folder move
failed merge outcomes rebase pauses and unconfirmed remote pushes do not advance time
status reads real full HEAD and never fabricates sync time
real conflicted merge retains earlier time until completed
clone completion is recorded only in the new working copy
unborn and detached status carry accurate commit identities
external commits refresh HEAD without pretending the app synced
